SGC Roofing & Construction - Your Trusted Partner for Roofing in DFW with over 15 years experience in the construction industry Welcome to SGC Roofing & Construction, where protection meets precision. We understand the impact of hail and wind damage on your property, and we're here to restore and fortify your home. Our expert team is dedicated to providing top-notch roofing solutions tailored to your needs. As a part of SGC Homes we know more than just roofs! Trust SGC Roofing & Construction for a reliable and resilient restoration experience. Refer us to your Friends! SCHEDULE INSPECTION SCHEDULE INSPECTION Follow Our Work On FACEBOOK & INSTAGRAM Explore Our Services. ROOF REPAIRS Precision Repairs, Unmatched Expertise Whether it's minor leaks or extensive damage, our skilled technicians at SGC Roofing & Construction specialize in precise roof repairs. We address issues promptly, ensuring the integrity of your roof and the safety of your home. DAMAGE RESTORATION Your Storm Damage Solution. When storms strike, trust SGC Roofing & Construction to provide comprehensive storm damage restoration services. From hail to wind damage, we meticulously restore your property, making it resilient against future challenges. PROPERTY PROTECTION Beyond Roofs - Safeguarding Your Home SGC Roofing & Construction goes beyond traditional roofing solutions. We offer full-scale property protection, ensuring that your entire home is shielded from potential risks. From roofing to property fortification, we've got you covered. Our Mission. Built on Trust - Every Decision Matters At SGC, we believe in accountability and integrity in every aspect of our work. We make decisions with your trust in mind, ensuring that our commitment to excellence extends beyond each repair or restoration. Explore Passionate Craftsmanship, Lasting Excellence A passion for excellence drives our team at SGC. We approach each project with dedication, ensuring that the craftsmanship invested in your roof reflects our commitment to providing lasting solutions. Discover Guiding Success, One Real Decision at a Time SGC is not just about roofs; it's about empowering homeowners. Through transparent communication and personalized service, we aim to empower you with the knowledge and confidence needed for a resilient and secure home. Take The Next Step FAQs Do you offer roof inspections? Yes! We provide free inspection services to identify potential problems before they become major issues. We can make small repairs or Full Replacements. Can you help with the insurance claims process? Yes, We can help you with your claims process but SGC Roofing & Construction acts solely as a contractor and not as a public adjuster. Any assistance provided with insurance claims is intended only to facilitate the repair process. Can you waive my deductible? In Texas, waiving a deductible is illegal under the Texas Insurance Code (Section 707.004), which requires policyholders to pay their deductible in full as part of an insurance claim. Roofing companies offering to waive deductibles are violating state law. Do you offer financing options? Yes, we provide many financing options to help ease the cost of our services. Secure Your Home with SGC! Choose SGC Roofing & Construction for unmatched roofing excellence. Our commitment to precision, integrity, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. Discover the SGC difference – where excellence meets every roofing project. Experience Excellence Contact Us Today. data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with strong evidence of real customer experiences. The company shows expertise in insurance claim navigation, which explains the detailed positive reviews. The lack of negative reviews is notable but plausible given the small sample size (8 Google reviews) and the company's focus on insurance claim assistance where customers often feel grateful for successful outcomes.
fake_signals: All sampled reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Some reviews are very brief and generic (e.g., 'Jerry is simply a master')
authentic_signals: Multiple specific employee names mentioned (Ojani, Rene, Jerry, Anthony)
Detailed descriptions of insurance claim processes
Specific project scenarios described (emergency leak, denied claim overturned)
Mention of working with other companies when appropriate
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available platform ratings are consistently high (5.0 on Google/Angi, A on BBB). No negative ratings found to create discrepancies.

reviews.text:
I had an outstanding experience with SGC Roofing & Construction. From start to finish, Ojani made the entire process smooth and stress-free. The communication was excellent — he kept me informed every step of the way and handled all coordination with my insurance company, which made things so much easier on my end. I even had the pleasure of communicating and working with Rene and Jerry. All very informative and respectful. Their team was flexible with scheduling and consistently went above and beyond to make sure everything was done right. The workmanship and professionalism were top-tier.
I’m now a customer for life and will recommend SGC Roofing & Construction to everyone I know. Truly a five-star company!
reviews.author: Destiney Fullerton

reviews.text: We had an excellent experience from start to finish. Anthony was extremely knowledgeable, answered every question we had, and explained the entire roofing process clearly, which made everything feel easy and stress-free. Communication was great, the process was smooth, and we felt confident we were in good hands the whole time. On top of that, Anthony was very personable and professional, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Priscilla P.

reviews.text: Jerry and his team at SGC Roofing and Construction were incredible from start to finish. After my initial claim was denied, they stepped in and handled everything with the insurance company—resubmitting documentation, staying professional and persistent, and ultimately getting my roof approved. It was a long process, but these guys are true pros. Jerry walked me through every step in a way that was easy to understand—I was even able to explain it to my wife like I knew what I was talking about! If you’re in the DFW area and need help with your roof or an insurance claim, I highly recommend SGC. They know exactly what they’re doing. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.author: Eddie Allen

reviews.text: This review is not based on work done but on my experience with SGC. While I ended up getting the roof done with another company I wanted to leave a review that working with Anthony was pleasant and professional. He would consistently check in on me where I was in the process and always respectful of my time and where I was. Would definitely recommend reaching out for roofing needs to get great information. Their quotes were fair and willing to work within insurance.
reviews.author: Ryan T

reviews.text: SGC Roofing and Construction did an excellent job regarding putting a new roof on my house. Kudos to the workers who made that happen.  Anthony had done a thorough inspection of the roof and identified damaged shingles on the roof along with other structural damage which he provided photos of to my cell phone, so that I could see what he found. Upon agreement to have a new roof, he showed me the shingles to be used and what color I could choose from and basically explained what would happen on the day the new roof was to be put on. He answered any questions I had regarding the procedure.  Also, two new roof turbines were also put on the roof to make it look even better.  I was thoroughly satisfied with the whole process from beginning to end, and the roof looks great.  I would highly recommend SGC to put on a new roof on any house.
reviews.author: Adrian Littlefield

reviews.text: Jerry is simply a master at his work. The entire staff is amazing. Great communication, anything I needed they got it done in a reasonable time. If you need anything roofing these are your guys.
reviews.author: Isiah Mikali-Lee

reviews.text:
I had talked to serval contractor's that right of the bat trying to up sale me with a new roof that cost just about 1/2 the value of my home. I found SGC Roofing on Angies list.
I delt with Jerry Cambric, he was pleasant do deal with. My insurance company denied my claim because there was too much granular lose due to the age of shingles.
Jerry told me not to worry about the denied claim that he will deal with the insurance himself. He was able to get the report decision overturned.
Jerry kept me informed every step of the way. Jerrys crew was very professional & well trained.
I would recommend SGC Roofing to anybody that is looking to have new shingles put on their home & I give them a 5+++ business.

Thank you, Jerry, for fighting the insurance company on my behave.
reviews.author: GySgt USMC

reviews.text: This company deserves more than 5 stars, I had an emergency after a heavy downpour, my back home had two places that leaked water including the room of my 81yr old disabled mother's bedroom. I was in a panic not knowing what to expect having little to no knowledge of the damages and so forth. Anothony Perez called back in record timing and understood the panic I had not only about my roof damage but the wellbeing of my mother. I talked to him and within 45 minutes he was at my home on the roof inspecting all of the damage. He showed me pictures of everything he found and actually tarped the exposed areas to avoid further water from leaking in my home until we were able to repair it. Anthony Perez is extremely professional and knowledgeable as well as caring for the homeowner which made my disaster alot easier to deal with. 5 stars is not enough for this company
reviews.author: Christine
